section: Venus Bike Club (formerly Venus de Miles Bike Club)

evidence.text: Full Cycle, the oldest bike shop in Boulder, Colorado USA, started the Venus de Miles Bike Club in 2009 as a way to introduce women to cycling, help them train for the Venus de Miles ride, have fun, and benefit Greenhouse Scholars.
The Venus Bike Club now has over 200 members and 1,000+ followers.
This recreational, non-competitive, no-drop, women's cycling club is about sisterhood—supporting members' emotional and physical growth into strong, beautiful women.
